Circuit de Nevers Magny-Cours · survey

id magny_cours · France · French GP (classic, last run 2008) · theme green, day-only (night:false) · branch cursor/magny_cours-survey-a1 @ 1eb5244 (+ report commit) · surveyed 2026-10-15 · read-only (no js/css edits)
Merges: shared-shot-tooling-5b45 applied; day-wet-lighting-b7b8 (#1979) applied cleanly, verify-track OK after both. 72 frames, TLX renderer, SwiftShader.

Top findings

  1. Sky is saturated ultramarine in every dry day frame, against a brief that asks for soft, cool, slightly overcast, flat light. js/circuits/magny_cours.js pal.zenith [0.32,0.48,0.70] with sunDir y≈0.62 (lightState sunY 0.81).
  2. Fog does not touch the sky (fog frames: hazy ground, hard blue band above). Probably engine/lighting, not this circuit. fogDensity 0.000765 is tiny.
  3. Woodland where the brief wants open farmland and poplar rows (frac 0.5 frame). Random every(30) trees, pines and copses mix with the rows.
  4. Tree look: furniture.treeCrown:"weeping" renders inverted mushroom crowns; hedges render as crenellated block walls; spectatorHill reads as a bare green wedge.
  5. Adelaide and Lycée furniture is keyed 0.025–0.05 lap (110–220 m) before the listed apexes (arithmetic from the def, not visually confirmed).

Tooling findings (for the parent)

  • build-gallery.cjs --help says --out DIR but the parser reads only --out=DIR (line 644). The space form was ignored and the tracked gallery/tracks/ files were rewritten (reverted by me).
  • WEATHER_TAIL lacks storm, so storm frames parse as tod unknown. Brief-style weather-tod names also misparse; frames use view-tod-weather.
  • The manifest lists my frames twice (working tree and pushed branch copy): 125 entries for 72 frames.
  • Orbit/trackside at frac 0 can sit behind the pit roof; the camera step-around does not clear it.

Not captured / uncertain

  • No dawn frames, no night/dusk wet beyond orbit, no trackside/eye for non-dry weather or dusk/night (time cap).
  • No EYE/close views of the ferme, bourg, Conservatoire, control block or tyre walls, so the corner-furniture offset (#4) and the Estoril canopy (#9) are unconfirmed.
  • Per-turn curvature table omitted: my sampling index was not aligned to the racing frac.
  • Banking 3–3.5° declared but not seen in the sampled array; no cornering shot taken to check.
  • Real-world facts are from the repo brief; no new web research.
  • Pixel evidence comes from SwiftShader on TLX only; WGX/GLX not checked.
